source_review.notes: Reviewed the Conchon-Filliâtre persistent union-find paper and author-maintained implementations, the Driscoll et al. persistence paper, Gaibisso-Gambosi-Talamo partial-persistence paper, Dietz-Raman report, official Sedgewick-Wayne union-find implementation/case study, and the current AFP relational disjoint-set proof. All eight final destinations returned HTTP 200.

evidence: Checked universe, partition/equivalence, parent/rank/component count, representative, depth, compression write set, snapshots, partial/full/confluent version topology, diffs, rerooting, and observational persistence.
Checked element union versus version merge, rollback versus persistence, representative versus stable identity, and logical partition versus forest shape remain distinct.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Classical inverse-Ackermann claims are confined to their exact ephemeral path-compressed model.

evidence: Recomputed the eight executable versions and expected partitions, including incomparable v4/v5 branches.
Recomputed component counts five at v3 and two at v7, maximum observed parent depth two, and the connected/isolated queries.
Recomputed rank-r minimum size 2^r and impossibility of rank three in a seven-element universe.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The tuple model copies Theta(n) storage and its small depth is not persistent-array or performance evidence.

evidence: Verified parent-root reachability induces the represented equivalence relation and root linking merges exactly two classes.
Verified the union-by-rank induction: rank r implies at least 2^r elements and logarithmic height without compression.
Verified pure immutable parent/rank versions give branch isolation and that substrate access cost composes with forest depth.
Verified rollback requires reversing every mutation, historical find uses versioned parent at every hop, and hidden reroot mutation needs a refinement/observational-persistence proof.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Pure full persistence, rollback, partial histories, rerooted persistent arrays, and confluent version merge are separate designs.

evidence: Reviewed zero/fixed universe, out-of-range, self/already-connected union, equal/unequal rank, balanced/chained forests, branch from every version, and representative instability.

Reviewed compression-write logging, no-op markers, nested rollback, stale/cross-DSU/future handles, rollback then new future, historical versions, reroot access alternation, mid-reroot failure, and recursive depth.

Reviewed tuple/page copy amplification, rank/count overflow, metadata restore, root/diff/log/reader pinning, races/CAS/ABA, malicious parent/version cycles, history authorization, and crash publication.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Quotas cover universe, versions/branches/snapshots/readers, paths/diffs/logs, metadata, serialized history, rate, memory, and diagnostics.

evidence: The executable checks parent/rank lengths, parent ranges, acyclicity/termination, strictly increasing rank along edges, root rank bounds, component count, and exact independent partitions for every version.
It checks read-only find, idempotent same-class root reuse, old-version queries, full branch isolation, and maximum depth.
The chapter specifies separate rollback log, version ancestry/history, reroot refinement, lifetime, concurrency, serialization, and durable-history validators.
invariant_checking.notes: The trace covers pure immutable union-by-rank without compression only.

evidence: Reviewed partition/representative semantics, classical heuristics, pure immutable baseline/cost composition, rollback, and partial histories.
Reviewed persistent arrays/rerooting/observational mutation, general transformations, full/confluent distinctions, metadata/identity, failure, concurrency, and serialization/durability.
Reviewed security/resources, independent partition/forest/version/log evidence, metamorphic/fault/concurrency/parser tests, and benchmark dimensions.
proof_review.notes: The formally reviewed Conchon-Filliâtre construction is not generalized to unverified ports or arbitrary concurrency.

evidence: Partition abstraction, rank-height, pure persistence, rollback, history, hidden-mutation refinement, complexity, and lifecycle arguments state separate assumptions.
Offline deletion scheduling is distinguished from online DSU deletion/splitting.
The executable explicitly disclaims compression, rollback, rerooting, concurrency, storage, and performance proof.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No persistence model, compression policy, or parent substrate is claimed universally optimal.

evidence: The standard-library-only Python trace passed exact thirteen-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under Python 3.14.4.
It emits evidence=finite_persistent_union_find_trace and reproduces partition merging, branching, idempotence, rank/depth, queries, and all version invariants.
All eight final external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local links passed draft module validation.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No path compression, rollback, partial history, persistent-array rerooting, fault injection, reclamation, concurrency, serialization, crash recovery, hostile parser, or production performance was empirically evaluated.

conceptual_review.notes: Progresses from partition semantics and classical heuristics through pure full persistence, rollback, partial histories, hidden-mutation persistent arrays, then lifecycle, concurrency, storage, security, and evidence.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed fixed/dynamic universe, opaque version/snapshot/representative handles, substrate costs, compression logging, rollback scopes, offline time traversal, reroot exceptions/threading, component metadata, root/diff/log retention, CAS, logical/checkpoint formats, commit publication/recovery/GC/migration, quotas, faults, and metrics.

pedagogical_review.notes: Begins with partition semantics and the rank proof, contrasts four persistence models concretely, includes a reproducible branching trace, ten varied examples, and five graduate exercises with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Conchon/Filliâtre, Driscoll/Sarnak/Sleator/Tarjan, Gaibisso/Gambosi/Talamo, Dietz/Raman, Sedgewick/Wayne, Isabelle/AFP, persistence, security, performance, reliability, storage, or independent practitioner review is claimed.
